object: FOLD//BLOOM LIVE 0.7 / motion correction + projection donor
observed_exactly_recovered: User reports current TRACKFIELD does not visibly go up/down enough and speed is unclear.
User reports normal/no-MP3 mode does not show the same effect.
User reports desktop rendering feels somewhat glitchy rather than smooth.
User clarifies the READFIELD idea is more about the ring/waveform/playhead moving through an addressed stream and should stay closer to AXIAL/Lens semantics than to music feature telemetry.
diagnosis: Previous grade signal affected only a small fraction of screen geometry.
TRACKFIELD used nearest-frame feature sampling plus ~55 ms cache, creating visible stepping at frame boundaries.
Renderer intentionally introduced thresholded high-frequency shake during high flux.
Visual road depth assumed near-uniform traversal; energy/flux did not materially change spatial distance per second.
No local AUDIO MAP existed in ordinary mode, so no road/deformation world existed.
implemented: Interpolated AUDIO MAP sampling with local temporal smoothing.
Explicit grade: quiet/low-flux climbs; energetic/flux-heavy descends.
Explicit visual speed: energy + flux increases spatial distance/FOV/flow while source playback stays 1×.
Explicit bend: low↔high spectral balance plus brightness controls curvature.
Cumulative altitude integrated across the future horizon and projected strongly into screen Y.
Future distance integrated from local speed so intense passages occupy/advance through more spatial distance.
Low-pass camera speed/grade/bend replaces thresholded flux shake.
FIELD COURSE: deterministic synthetic normal-mode map with beats, sections, climbs, turns, breaks and surges.
Normal mode uses the same deformation tape and ride logic; road writing no longer requires an MP3.
Silent autoplay preview may write reversible FIELD COURSE deformations and restores clean state.
VEL/GRADE HUD witnesses make mapping inspectable.

simple_mapping.grade: (.50 - energy) × 1.34 - flux × .16; positive = climb, negative = descent
simple_mapping.speed: .72 + energy × .72 + flux × .36, bounded .62–1.86 visual traversal multiplier
simple_mapping.source_rate: audio remains 1×; current speed is visual/spatial traversal, not hidden time-stretch

readfield_projection_donor.do_not_copy: music metrics, racer HUD, score grammar
readfield_projection_donor.axial_lens_rule: AXIAL/Lens changes the projection around the same addressed point; it should not silently create a second reading state.
readfield_projection_donor.interpretation: The useful donor from LIVE is that the point being consumed visibly moves through a future structure. For reading, structure should come from text features and document topology, not borrowed music semantics.

successor_laws: NORMAL MODE MUST EXERCISE THE SAME CORE MECHANISM AS CUSTOM-MP3 MODE.
VISUAL SPEED IS NOT AUDIO RATE UNLESS EXPLICITLY DESIGNED.
READFIELD SHOULD SHARE ADDRESS/PROJECTION, NOT RACER SKIN.
next_truth: Desktop + phone: can a player see an unmistakable climb and descent without reading GRADE?
Does an energetic passage visibly feel faster while the audio remains phase-locked?
Does FIELD COURSE make PLAY FIELD a legitimate mode rather than a blank fallback?
Is motion materially smoother after interpolation and removal of flux shake?
Do FOLD/SPLIT/RETURN remain categorically legible after smoothing?
stop: Do not add time-stretch, provider catalogs, lane collectibles, or READFIELD implementation until motion evidence returns.

verification.regression_caught: Initial smoothed SURGE detector lost anticipation because it depended on adjacent-frame spikes; CI failed, detector was rewritten as short-window impact rise, then full suite passed.
